## Added

- Check for updates at any time using the icon on the right of the usage window. It spins while checking, then shows when an update is available or ready to install.
- Preview an update's release notes by hovering over its icon, including after downloading it. You can also focus the icon and press Shift+F10 to open the scrollable notes.

## Improvements

- Release notes in Settings > About have a simpler heading, clearer section spacing and larger, selectable text.

Release-note previews are available for updates that include notes in their update metadata. Older releases may show that notes are unavailable.
